data.transforms: SHA256 bits independently select horizontal flip, vertical flip, and coherent A/B part-group permutation
data.inference_inputs: Frozen RGB-derived features; normalized part prompts from frame zero; sibling-group relation
data.forbidden_inference_inputs: Later masks; owner masks; seed; condition; motion parameters; transform metadata
data.learning: Supervised learned head over frozen JEPA features; not self-supervised training
data.visibility: Day4 >=70% pair coverage and >=65% each frame; absent iff zero target pixels in both frames
data.exclusions: Tubelet zero and ambiguous visible slivers
data.scope: Held-out seeds in the same three 2-D procedural trajectory families; no real-video/OOD claim

annotation: frame-zero part masks only; no SAM or parent-mask annotations
encoder_context: Four independent 16-frame blocks; offline within each block
